claims.claim: Direct America very neet and tested ok, with 3 month guarantee
claims.evidence: Witness report shows a used engine assembly with dirt/wear and no readable test/guarantee evidence; no running/test footage or written warranty proof shown.
Witness report shows no readable origin/auction/import markings; no documents or labels confirming Belgium shown.
Witness report includes only visual inspection; no start-up sound/video, no compression/leak-down results, and no knock test evidence shown.
Witness report shows no readable mileage/ECU data or odometer; engine make/model and variant are not readable.
Witness report shows external wear/corrosion and does not show tamper-proof indicators (e.g., opened seals/fasteners) clearly enough to confirm internal opening status.

risks.risk: Engine make/model/variant is not readable, so compatibility and correct pricing are uncertain (wrong engine for the buyer’s car).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine ID plate/stamping (engine block casting number) and the full model/variant label, plus the VIN/engine code it matches.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unidentified used engine assembly with unknown compatibility and unknown internal condition.

risks.risk: No proof it actually runs/has no knock; visual condition alone cannot confirm internal health.
risks.proof: Short video of the engine starting and running (cold start if possible) with a brief idle and audible check for knocking, plus any test sheet (compression/leak-down).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven running/untested; treat as higher risk for internal faults.

risks.risk: Possible corrosion/rust and heavy wear on casing/parts could indicate poor storage or water ingress.
risks.proof: Close-up shots of the worst rust/corrosion areas and any signs of coolant/oil contamination; also show underside and timing cover area if accessible.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case for storage-related damage (as-is, higher chance of needing repairs).

risks.risk: Missing or damaged components (starter/alternator/sensors/ECU/mounts) are not shown; engine assembly may be incomplete.
risks.proof: Photo checklist showing all included parts laid out (starter, alternator, sensors, ECU if present, mounts, wiring harness connectors) and a view of mounting points/threads.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially incomplete/unknown accessories; assume buyer may need to source missing parts.

risks.risk: Transmission/gearbox compatibility and mounting details are unknown if any mating parts are included.
risks.proof: Photos of the mating surface/adapter plate and any gearbox/adapter included, with part numbers and mounting bolt patterns.
risks.if_unproven: Price as engine-only or unknown mating compatibility; assume additional parts/work may be required.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the engine block casting number/engine ID plate (readable) and the exact engine code/variant.
Send a short video of the engine starting and running (preferably cold start) showing idle sound (no knock) and stable operation.
Provide any test results (compression/leak-down/overheating) or a written test sheet with date.
Show close-ups of the worst corrosion/rust areas and the timing/cylinder head area (if accessible) to assess internal risk.
Confirm what is included: starter, alternator, sensors, ECU, wiring harness, mounts—send photos of each item laid out and mounting points/threads.
response.reason: The witness can identify it as a used internal combustion engine assembly, but make/model and running/test status are not verifiable from the report. So it can be priced at its worst-case for an unidentified, unproven engine condition in Lagos.
